They were led by head coach [[Tad Boyle]] in his eighth season at Colorado. The Buffaloes played their home games at [[Coors Events Center]] in [[Boulder, Colorado]] as members of the [[Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 17–15, 8–10 in Pac-12 play to finish in a tie for eighth place. They defeated [[2017–18 Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball team|Arizona State]] in the first round of the [[2018 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] before losing in the quarterfinals to [[2017–18 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team|Arizona]]. ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball team|Buffaloes]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 19–15, 8–10 in [[2016–17 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 play]] to finish in seventh place. They defeated [[2016–17 Washington State Cougars men's basketball team|Washington State]] in the first round of the [[2017 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] to advance to the quarterfinals where they lost to [[2016–17 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team|Arizona]].
